initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the dataset has a pedestrian-killed count per crash, so it can report the annual sum for the covered years 2013–2025
initial_plan.denominator: No denominator; this is a count, not a rate
initial_plan.population: Police-reported motor vehicle crash rows whose crash_date falls in calendar years 2013 through 2025; each crash's recorded pedestrian deaths contribute to its crash year
initial_plan.filters: crash_date year from 2013 through 2025 inclusive; no borough or outcome-value filter
initial_plan.data_check: Completed in check_1.csv: selected rows and annual row counts; crash-date span and common sentinel-date check; missingness of crash_date and the summed count

data_check_findings.rows: 2,132,218 crash rows in the 2013–2025 population; observed row counts are recorded per year in check_1.csv
data_check_findings.coverage: For every year 2013–2025, the earliest selected crash_date is January 1 and the latest is December 31; no year is partial by its observed date boundaries
data_check_findings.crash_date_quality: 0 missing or invalid dates within the selected population; 0 rows use the checked common date sentinels 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, or 2000-01-01. Rows with no assignable date cannot enter a year group and were outside the selected population check.
data_check_findings.pedestrian_killed_quality: 0 of 2,132,218 selected rows have number_of_pedestrians_killed missing (0 in every year).

decisions_after_data_check.crash_date: Keep all rows in 2013–2025. The date column is a typed DATE and all selected rows are year-assignable; no selected rows are dropped. Dates outside this range or unassignable dates cannot be assigned to a requested year.
decisions_after_data_check.number_of_pedestrians_killed: Keep all selected rows; none are missing, so no deaths are omitted and no imputation is needed.
decisions_after_data_check.coverage: Include all requested years; each year has selected dates spanning January 1 through December 31.

final_plan.can_answer: yes: the dataset supports the annual totals of recorded pedestrian deaths for 2013–2025
final_plan.metric: For each calendar year, the sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed across crash records
final_plan.denominator: None; report an absolute count, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash records with crash_date in calendar years 2013–2025; recorded pedestrian deaths on each crash record are assigned to its crash year
final_plan.filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 inclusive through 2026-01-01 exclusive; no borough or outcome-value filter
final_plan.years: 2013 through 2025 inclusive; each selected year has date observations from January 1 through December 31
final_plan.limitations: This describes counts recorded on police-reported crash rows, not exposure-adjusted risk or an independently validated count of every real-world death. The selected population has 2,132,218 rows, with 0 missing crash dates or pedestrian-killed counts in scope; each requested year spans Jan 1–Dec 31 by observed dates. Crash records with unassignable dates cannot be allocated to a year, and their count was outside this scoped data check.
